subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Is the current summarized legacy-upgrade evidence enough to merge this runtime stale-detection fallback, or should the PR wait for visible latest-head proof of the pre-code SQLite row rederiving successfully?
rationale: The code path changes persisted registry reuse during upgrade, and source inspection cannot replace maintainer acceptance of the proof bar for existing user state.

options.title: Require Latest-Head Legacy Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code no-pluginId/no-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and the Gateway or equivalent runtime registry path proceeds on the current PR head.

options.title: Accept Source And Test Proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge with source inspection, CI, and unit-test coverage only, accepting the remaining real-upgrade proof gap.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup Out Of Runtime
options.body: If runtime invalidation for legacy no-code rows is not desired, pause this PR and move that cleanup to doctor or migration-owned code.

recommendation.title: Require Latest-Head Legacy Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code no-pluginId/no-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and the Gateway or equivalent runtime registry path proceeds on the current PR head.
